name: zopt_get_wol_password_flag_value
description: zOpt::GetWolPasswordFlagValue returns the integer stored through the WOL password flag option pointer.
known_limits: Tier C only; no isolated VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x408a20 loads g_zOpt_WolPasswordFlagOption and returns the pointed-to integer value.

Native smoke zopt_wol_password_flag_accessor_smoke installs local option storage, verifies the initial getter value, toggles the value through zOpt::SetWolPasswordFlag, and verifies zOpt_GetWolPasswordFlagValue returns each updated value.
